head.title: Lovers a Riddle
head.source: Anne Weston (red.): For love's sweet sake; selected poems of love in all moods.

body.poetry:
The flame of love assuages, When once it is revealed; But fiercer still it rages The more it is concealed.
Consenting makes it colder, When met it will retreat; Repulses make it bolder, And dangers make it sweet.
